lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，山风就把我托住
lines.en: I spread my wings and the mountain wind holds me.

lines.zh: 地面在脚下一点点退远
lines.en: The ground recedes beneath me.

lines.zh: 我沿着翠绿山峰的轮廓滑翔
lines.en: I glide along the verdant peak's outline.

lines.zh: 翅膀几乎不用扇，风够用
lines.en: I barely beat my wings; the wind suffices.

lines.zh: 我侧身切进上升的气流
lines.en: I bank into the rising air.

lines.zh: 我的影子从山脊上掠过
lines.en: My shadow skims the ridgeline.

lines.zh: 羽毛在气流里发出细响
lines.en: My feathers hiss in the airflow.
I circle once, then climb.
I pass through the summit cloud.
I shift posture and drop a little.
A light press of tail feathers turns me.
I slide down along the rock face.
At this height I'm perfectly calm.
I spread both wings and hold in the air.
The air holds me steady.
I wheel above the valley.

lines.zh: 我悬停在半空，翅尖微颤
lines.en: I hover, wingtips trembling.
Below is a deep green.
I can rest without landing.
Cloud shadows slide over the valley.

lines.zh: 风从崖下来，猎物在下头。
lines.en: Wind from below the cliff; prey below.
My talons are tucked in feathers.
There's little sound up here.
My gaze stays downward.

lines.zh: 翅膀保持这个角度就好
lines.en: Keep the wings at this angle.
It's a bit colder than the ground.
I cant my wings slightly.
I wait for the wind to turn.

lines.zh: 翠绿的山谷在我转动的视野里
lines.en: The green valley turns through my view.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，跟空气一起
lines.en: I hold still, one with the air.
I look from above; you're below.
You look up for me. Hard to see.
My shadow arrives before I do.
Standing on the ridge, you're obvious.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀挡住了你一点阳光
lines.en: My wings block a little of your sunlight.
I drop two blocks for a better look.

lines.zh: 你不长翅膀，怎么上来的？
lines.en: Wingless — how did you get up here?

lines.zh: 我在你头顶画了一道弧
lines.en: I trace an arc over your head.
Don't look for me. I'll come.
At this height I'm out of reach.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一歪，往下掉了
lines.en: A wing tips and I drop.
Feathers drift through the air.
I beat hard to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我翻了一圈，重新找气流
lines.en: I tumble once and hunt for air again.
I lose a few blocks before recovering.
That leaves me flying crooked.
I hiss and climb.
A small tear in my wing membrane.
I can still fly. Easy.

lines.zh: 你把我从高空打下来过？
lines.en: Have you knocked me out of the sky?
You're holding it up, far below.

lines.zh: 高空中闻不到那个味道
lines.en: I can't smell it from up here.
To lure me, climb the cliff.
I circle once and don't descend.

lines.zh: 这东西对我没有吸引力
lines.en: That holds no attraction for me.
I look at it twice from above.
Set it down and I might come.
The wind scatters the smell.
I cant a wing and climb away.
On this mountain, food isn't the point.

lines.zh: 你在空中撞到我，翅一歪
lines.en: You hit me in the air; a wing tips.
I roll over and rebalance.
A few feathers scatter in the air.
The knock drops me a block.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，落在你的上方
lines.en: I swing clear and settle above you.
I hit a branch and lose speed.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过岩壁，声音很利
lines.en: My wing grazes rock with a sharp sound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我找了好久的平衡
lines.en: That took me a while to balance out.

lines.zh: 你抓不住我，风会带走我
lines.en: You can't hold me; the wind takes me.
Touch me again and I'll climb above the clouds.

lines.zh: 两只一起滑翔，气流更省力
lines.en: Gliding together saves effort.
Match my altitude.
My nest is on the ridge.
Only wind and us up this high.
Set your wings like mine.
The valley will stay green.

lines.zh: 我不用降落，也能陪着你飞
lines.en: I can stay with you without landing.
Cloud passes between us.
When the wind shifts, come close.
Then we wheel together until dusk.
I catch it in mid-air.
I need a talon hold to keep it.
It turns in my grip.
Too heavy, so I drop it.
The wind takes it away.
I caught it during the descent.
This can go back to the nest.
You threw it up? I caught it.
Carrying things aloft is awkward.
I'll hold it until I land.
I fold my wings and begin to descend.

lines.zh: 地面上的目标不会跑远
lines.en: A grounded target won't get far.
I've fixed your position.
This dive comes from behind you.
Talons first, wings after.
No cover on the ridge.
The wind helps me gather speed.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚边
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 你往上找我，找错了方向
lines.en: You're looking up the wrong way.
This lunge comes only once.

lines.zh: 我换了形态，翅膀已经张开。
lines.en: I've changed form — wings already spread.
Then here I come, dropping in.
I trim my wings for an angle.
Every move of yours, I correct.
I draw a circle above you.
The wind holds me steady.
Your hands stay over your head.
Then I come from the side.
You've gone to the ledge's edge.
At this distance one pass is enough.
My talons are already open.
Do you hear the wingbeats?
That sound is getting closer.
Don't look up. I'm right overhead.
One last circle.
I dive, talons trailing wind.
This rake lands on your back.
The impact pitches you forward.
My wing buffets you.
I grip for an instant and rise again.
Your pauldron is torn open.
I skim just above the ground.
This one goes for your nape.

lines.zh: 碎石被我的翅膀吹起来
lines.en: My wings kick up gravel.
I climb away to find a new angle.
You guard the front. The back is open.
I'm not done this pass.

lines.zh: 我从山峰上的状态里变了过来
lines.en: I shifted into this form on the peak.
Wings out, I leave the ledge.

lines.zh: 这一带的风正好托住我
lines.en: The wind here holds me just right.

lines.zh: 很少有飞着的我出现在这里
lines.en: The flying me rarely shows here.

lines.zh: 这不是自然生成，是状态变了
lines.en: This isn't a natural spawn. It's a state change.

lines.zh: 我绕着翠绿的山顶转了一圈
lines.en: I circle the verdant summit once.
The one below looked up.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，先飞一会
lines.en: Talons tucked, I'll fly a while.
The air up here is thin.
I glide along the cloud edge.
I like this view.
I'm here, from above.
A lift of wind and I'm up.
I circle, round and round.

lines.zh: 翅膀一着，我只能往下坠
lines.en: My wing catches and I can only fall.

lines.zh: 我撞在岩壁上，一路滑下去
lines.en: I hit the cliff and slide down it.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，羽毛全湿了
lines.en: I hit the water and my feathers soak.
The blast flips me over.
An arrow through the membrane makes me wobble.
That light stiffens my wings.
Too starved to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 雷在云里炸开，我直落下去
lines.en: Lightning cracks in the cloud and I plummet.

lines.zh: 没有风，翅膀抓不住任何东西
lines.en: No wind. My wings catch nothing.
